preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n - 1 and all(1 <= p[i] < i + 2 for i in range(n - 1))
preconditions.description: The parent array p must have exactly n-1 elements, where p[i] is the parent of node i+2 (1-based), and 1 ≤ p_i < i+2 for all i.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line) <= n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1].split())
preconditions.description: Each parent value in the input must be a valid node label between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output is a string representation of the number of valid leaf partitions modulo 998244353, where count_partitions(n, p) computes the number of ways to partition the leaves of the tree such that for any two distinct sets x and y in the partition, f(x) and f(y) are disjoint.
The output is a valid count of leaf partitions, where is_valid_partition(n, p, count) checks that count is the number of ways to partition leaves into disjoint f(L) subgraphs, modulo 998244353.
